{{Top|leg}}
A '''hull scrubber''' was a form of anti-theft system that was developed for use aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] by [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]], during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Swarm War]]. The hull scrubber used controlled bursts of [[Spectrum/Legends|electromagnetic]] energy to keep a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] or [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] from attaching itself to the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of a starship. One of the drawbacks to using a hull scrubber was that it did not remove [[Pulse shield|pulse-shielded]] droids, such as [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droids]], that could shield themselves from the electromagnetic energy.
